title: Logistics MultiWMSInventoryRecon

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the Multi-WMS Inventory Reconciliation analysis. The task involved reconciling wms_alpha.csv and wms_beta.csv, identifying a critical 100% inventory variance (10 units) for SKU A-1 at Warehouse WH1. Key deliverables include: (1) Python analysis code in code/inventory_reconciliation.py, (2) reconciliation results and KPIs in outputs/, (3) three visualization figures in report/images/, and (4) a comprehensive research report in report/report.md with methodology, results, discussion, and actionable recommendations for management. The analysis revealed a 0% reconciliation rate requiring immediate investigation.
